title: OKX总裁Gracie：非加密交易量从0到40%，加密正成为金融基础设施？
speaker: Gracie Chen

segments.en: Gracie, just talking about the business and the trends in the industry, just to pivot more broadly here. So I noticed that volumes on your platform and exchange have gone from zero on non-crypto to about 20% non-crypto. What does that tell you about trends right now in appetite for other assets?
segments.zh: Gracie，谈谈业务和行业趋势。我注意到你们平台非加密交易量从零升到约20%。这反映了对其他资产的需求趋势是什么？

segments.en: Yeah, so at its peak, March this year, our non-crypto trading volume was 40% of the total volume. So from zero to 40%, that's quite an increase within a year.
segments.zh: 是的，今年3月高峰时，我们的非加密交易量占总量的40%。从零到40%，一年内增长相当大。

segments.en: Indeed, Bitcoin is not just a crypto centralized exchange since about a year ago, with ourselves UX, Universal Exchange, that's where our users can trade universally valuable assets, including cryptocurrency, including equity, or tokenized equity, and commodities, and forex, and even pretty IPO stocks.
segments.zh: 大约一年前起，我们不再只是加密中心化交易所，而是UX通用交易所。用户可以交易各类有价值资产，包括加密货币、权益资产或代币化权益、大宗商品、外汇，甚至IPO前的份额。

segments.en: So many different asset classes that we are covering now. And I think that's an important trend that's happening in this industry. Like crypto is not just a small asset class that when people think about crypto, they think about Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many different meme coins, they put coin, altcoins, etc. That's not the case anymore.
segments.zh: 我们现在覆盖许多不同资产类别。这是行业的重要趋势。加密不再只是小资产类别，人们想到加密就想到比特币、以太坊、Solana和各种 meme 币、山寨币。情况已不再如此。

segments.en: At least in my opinion, crypto is more of a important technology infrastructure that's driving or empowering the traditional financial industry largely. And you've also seen organizations like NYSE and NASDAQ in the US who are digitalizing or tokenizing their assets, which is an important trend.
segments.zh: 至少在我看来，加密更像重要的技术基础设施，很大程度上推动或赋能传统金融行业。你也看到纽交所和纳斯达克等机构在数字化或代币化资产，这是重要趋势。

segments.en: Again, I think this industry is evolving to be more of an infrastructure, and that's largely the value of blockchain or crypto in the future. So we've captured that trend. We've listed tokenized stocks more than a year ago, and those trading assets have been doing pretty well on our platform. And that's the future as well.
segments.zh: 我认为这个行业正演变为基础设施，这正是区块链或加密未来的价值。我们抓住了这一趋势，一年多前就上线了代币化权益，这些交易资产在平台上表现不错。这也是未来方向。
